alt_before_after.before: Unspoken conversation. A quiet contemporary bedroom at night, a plain half-open window and two pillows separated by a small interval; moonlight reaches only part of an unmade cotton sheet. No figures. Absence and words withheld, intimate rather than melodramatic. Close oblique view, graphite and cool indigo watercolor.
alt_before_after.after: Moonlight falls across two pillows and a rumpled bed beside an open window.

alt_before_after.before: Leaving the known. The edge of a forest opens onto a pale, almost colourless horizon; a narrow ordinary path leaves the trees and disappears into light. No person, symbolic bird, stairs or heavenly gates. A few near branches retain subdued green while distant shapes dissolve naturally. Minimal wet watercolor and dry charcoal, generous negative space.
alt_before_after.after: Watercolor of a narrow path along a wooded hillside, opening onto a pale, misty valley.

alt_before_after.before: An invitation held open. A close oblique view of two plain cups of tea on a modest mahogany-toned cafe table, one cup near the cropped hand of a listener and the other beside an empty chair partly out of frame. Contemporary urban interior, faint shapes of buildings beyond a window. No animal skin, no text, no ornamental teapot. Restrained watercolor, intimate uneven arrangement.
alt_before_after.after: Watercolor of two cups of tea on a café table, with a person’s hand beside one cup and an empty chair opposite.

alt_before_after.before: A hill that waits. A low dark hill seen from a dry sandy plain under thin moonlight, its long shape faintly resembling a boat without becoming one. Small uncertain footprints stop in the foreground; no person, monuments, battle, or literal ship. Distance ambiguous, a broad still horizon. Charcoal with diluted blue-grey watercolor.
alt_before_after.after: Footprints cross a moonlit sandy plain toward a low, dark hill.

alt_before_after.before: A small light of trust. A close view of a single simple clay oil lamp burning on an ordinary indoor stone sill in darkness, flame small and physically plausible, a little of the room visible. Devotion to Jagannath expressed through hope and light, no invented deity, temple interior, ritual arrangement or religious emblem. Warm restrained watercolor, abundant quiet dark space.
alt_before_after.after: A small clay oil lamp lights a windowsill in a dark room.

alt_before_after.before: Companions without conditions. Two adults seen from behind, seated naturally some distance apart on a broad riverbank at late dusk; one turns slightly toward the other. Faces not visible, contemporary simple clothing, flowing water barely reflecting them. No romantic posing, no moon disc, no lotus props. Low viewpoint, indigo ink and restrained watercolor.
alt_before_after.after: Two people sit apart on a riverbank beneath a blue and rose dusk sky.

alt_before_after.before: Words in spring. A contemporary desk with a partly used unlettered notebook, pen and an open window; beyond the frame only a small blurred patch of yellow mustard flowers. Afternoon available light, writing as a private gesture. No readable writing, no goddess, no bridal symbols. Delicate watercolor with selective graphite, cropped close composition.
alt_before_after.after: An open notebook and pen rest beside a sunlit window overlooking yellow flowers.

alt_before_after.before: Rain at the river. Two adults partly cropped, shoulders touching naturally under rain by a river; seen from behind, their faces not shown. Rain dimples grey water, fabric darkens where wet. Quiet intimacy, no erotic exposure, no cinematic embrace. Wide observational watercolor in slate blue and earthy rose.
alt_before_after.after: Two people sit close together beside a river in the rain.

alt_before_after.before: A moment of company. At an ordinary roadside bus stop, two adults sit quietly on a plain bench with a little space between them; one offers the other a seat by moving a bag. Honest companionship without staged eye contact. Contemporary small-town India, flat overcast light, no lettering. Loosely observed graphite and muted watercolor.
alt_before_after.after: Two people sit on a roadside bench with a bag between them and a bus in the background.

alt_before_after.before: A glance instead of words. Interior close crop at a plain cafe window: an adult woman in partial profile looks toward someone just outside the frame. Her face partly in soft shadow, a thoughtful ordinary expression, no glamour or idealisation. Glass reflects a faint second silhouette without impossible anatomy. Restrained watercolor, rose-grey and graphite.
alt_before_after.after: A woman rests her chin on her hand at a café table beside a window.

alt_before_after.before: Beyond an imposed reading. A contemporary woman alone at a window, seen from the back in an ordinary room, one hand resting firmly on the sill. On the desk an unmarked sheet lies in indirect shadow. The posture suggests reclaiming agency after others have misread her, without illustrating sexual violence, restraint or gossiping faces. Cool natural daylight, bold quiet shapes, watercolor and pencil.
alt_before_after.after: A woman stands at an open window overlooking trees, with a sheet of paper on the desk behind her.

alt_before_after.before: A city looks upward. Street-level view looking up between contemporary Mumbai apartment towers, practical balconies and uneven windows, small slice of pale sky. A cropped pedestrian at the bottom waits, no iconic landmark montage, no billboards or text. Observe ambition and ordinary city scale without dystopian exaggeration. Grey ink drawing with restrained aqua watercolor.
alt_before_after.after: A pedestrian looks upward between tall apartment buildings.

alt_before_after.before: An unharnessed river. A broad freely winding river through an open landscape, an unhurried bird small and off-centre, unbroken sky with ordinary uneven clouds. Sense of freedom and kindness without utopian architecture, fantasy sunbeams or staged flowers. View from a low grassy bank. Luminous but restrained watercolor, pale blue, olive and ochre.
alt_before_after.after: A broad river curves past grassy banks beneath a cloud-filled sky and a distant bird.

alt_before_after.before: The guest has gone. An ordinary apartment entrance seen from indoors just after a visit: the door ajar, a quiet strip of afternoon light on the floor, a coat half visible on a hook. No person, no anthropomorphic joy or sorrow, no decorative clutter. Medium close composition, muted grey-green watercolor, warmth limited to the light.
alt_before_after.after: Sunlight falls through a partly open door onto a woven mat, beside a hanging shawl and a shoe rack.

alt_before_after.before: Life continues in the work. Close crop of an adult hand writing at a simple desk beside a window, fingers anatomically plausible, marks on paper not legible. A living vine outside is partly cropped, human effort and hope suggested through action. No literal blood, bone or manifesto slogans. Graphite drawing, earthy watercolor and restrained daylight.
alt_before_after.after: A hand writes in an open notebook beside a sunlit window and a climbing vine.

alt_before_after.before: Love in an ordinary gesture. An elderly parent and adult child seen only through their hands at a kitchen table; one gently supports the other hand while passing an ordinary glass of water. No sacred symbols, staged smiles or excessive props. Human tenderness, imperfect lived-in table, daylight from one side. Warm-grey and mulberry watercolor, careful credible hands.
alt_before_after.after: Younger hands support an older person’s hands around a glass of water at a kitchen table.

alt_before_after.before: A thaw at dusk. A dark muted rose caught by the last indirect evening light beside a small run of water; petals partially folded, natural imperfect shape, no glittering frost, no deity or Adam-and-Eve figures. A quiet suggestion of inner thaw, symbolic but physically believable. Deep brown-rose and blue-grey watercolor, close low viewpoint.
alt_before_after.after: A dark rose rests beside a small stream reflecting the evening sky.

alt_before_after.before: Village at evening. An imagined hillside village at dusk after rain, a modest lane leading toward low houses, two cattle returning naturally along the lane, very light smoke rising from one roof and a few early stars. No staged smiling villagers or identical cottages, no lavish temple, no exotic costume. Distant hill shapes hold the scene. Soft watercolor and pencil, muted pink-grey sky and natural earth colours.
alt_before_after.after: Two cattle walk along a wet village lane between stone walls and hillside houses at dusk.
